messages:
Alex K: quick heads-up — I ran a focused A100 vs H100 multi-region sweep for Llama-2-13B (nf4/int8) and Mistral-7B (nf4/int8). Goal: prefill + decode p50/p95, tokens/sec, and ~$ per 1M tokens for us-west-2 / eu-west-1 / ap-southeast-1. dropping raw numbers below, please sanity-check and flag anything suspicious.

Jia L: nice, paste results pls and include batch/seq settings. did you pin kernels? :eyes:

Alex K: ran with batch=8 for throughput runs and batch=1 for latency; seq=1024 (prefill), decode length=256. kernels: autoselect (flash_attn preferred on H100, cutlass fallback on A100). pricing used on-demand GPU hourly + token cost model we discussed.

Samir: quick summary observations: H100 wins p50 prefill by ~35-40% and tokens/sec ~1.6-1.8x across both models. A100 has higher variance at p95 on long seqs. nf4/int8 on H100 is stable; on A100 int8 needs a different kernel (no fused flash) and shows slightly higher decode latency.

Marco: command I used to repro (us-west-2 H100 throughput):
```
bench --model llama-2-13b-nf4 --quant int8 --device h100 --batch 8 --seq 1024 --decode 256 --region us-west-2 --kernels auto
```

Samir: raw table (rounded):
Model | Device | p50 prefill ms | p95 decode ms | tokens/sec | $/1M tokens
Llama-2-13B int8 | H100 | 280 | 520 | 1450 | 11.8
Llama-2-13B int8 | A100 | 460 | 880 | 820 | 18.6
Mistral-7B int8 | H100 | 160 | 300 | 2600 | 7.2
Mistral-7B int8 | A100 | 270 | 480 | 1500 | 11.2

Jia L: region delta: eu-west-1 p50s were +10-15% vs us-west-2, ap-southeast-1 adds +25-35% latency but cheaper per-GPU hr — cost-per-1M-tokens shifts down ~8-12% for ap-southeast after billing differences.

Marco: KV-cache note: enabling prefix cache for repeated system prompts reduced prefill by ~30% on H100 (batch=1 lat runs). so app-level caching still a huge lever.

Samir: kernel detail: H100 -> prefer `flash_attn_v2 + fused_gemm` path; A100 -> `cutlass + cached_kv` gives more stable memory footprint. When H100 used fallback cutlass the tokens/sec collapsed to near A100 numbers.

Alex K: quality check — ran 200 eval prompts (deterministic seed) comparing nf4 vs fp16 for Llama-2-13B: chrF/ROUGE diffs <0.6 points in aggregate, but 6/200 prompts had minor truncation; logging them to S3 (s3://redwood-bench/1772103030/diffs.json).

bench-bot: benchmark run complete — job id b-1772103030, artifacts: s3://redwood-bench/1772103030/{llama13_h100, llama13_a100, mistral7_h100}.csv

Jia L: action items: 1) Marco/Samir — run batch sweep [1,4,8] in eu-west-1 & ap-southeast-1 (same seed) and capture p50/p95 + tokens/sec. 2) Alex — publish cost calc notebook. 3) Ops — consider H100 capacity bump for latency-critical routes (can A/B on canary?).

Samir: one more callout — for small models (<=7B) A100 is competitive on cost if you run aggressively batched workloads; H100 advantage grows with sequence length and lower batch.

Alex K: thanks — assigning to Marco/Samir to kick off region sweeps. I'll start the cost notebook + put a short note in the perf playbook about kernel hints. :thumbsup:
